# Lamp

Lamp runs isolated virtual machines on hardware you own. Interfaces: CLI, MCP,
HTTP API. SDK work is deferred.

- [Install and first sandbox](docs/install.md): two-command quickstart, host prerequisites, paths and credentials. The public 0.1.1 download does not yet include this next-release path.
- [README](README.md): product overview and source build.
- [API schema](contracts/public/schema.json): canonical request shapes; a schema operation may require separate host enrollment.
- [Release notes](docs/release/0.1.1.md): historical shipped surface and limitations.
- [Measurements](docs/release/measurements.md): historical results, including missed targets.
